name: @voxpelli/ast-grep-rules
description: Portable, project-authored ast-grep YAML lint rules enforcing house JSDoc/ESM JS conventions (prefer unknown over any, drop {object} from @typedef, hoist inline import('module').Type). Consumed via sgconfig.yml ruleDirs. Data-only (no JS). EXPERIMENTAL staging of a cross-repo extraction from vp-claude's .ast-grep/rules.
author: Pelle Wessman <pelle@kodfabrik.se> (https://kodfabrik.se/)
